entities.name: PMID:25433014
observations: 2015 African green monkey H7N9 study: intravenous IFX-1 anti-C5a substantially attenuated lung histopathology and macrophage/neutrophil infiltration, reduced systemic inflammation and lung viral titers.

entities.name: IFX-1
observations: Neutralizing antihuman C5a antibody used intravenously in H7N9-infected African green monkeys; blocked C5a-mediated granulocyte CD11b expression without impairing C5b membrane attack complex formation.

entities.name: Anti-C5a in monkey H7N9
observations: In an African green monkey H7N9 infection study, IFX-1 treatment reduced lung histopathologic injury, inflammatory cell infiltration, systemic inflammatory response, and lung virus titers; abstract does not report survival benefit.
